audit_items.proof_trace: The balance deduction is enforced by Move's `Balance::split(amount)` primitive (ctoken_table.move:89), which by the resource-type system guarantees exactly `amount` is deducted. The shadow table `ctoken_values` is updated atomically to `in_bag_balance.value()` (= pre_balance - amount) or removed when zero, so `ctoken_value_by_coin_type` always returns the correct post-withdrawal value. All callers of ctoken balance reduction (handle_withdraw at market.move:328, liquidation at market.move:776) go through this same path — no bypass exists.
